critical_code_review_comments: readiness_engine.py cleanly versions BOMs (plan_version stamped for staleness detection), inventory match is deterministic token-overlap (transparent), status changes propagate to gr_plans tools_materials, compat ask logs gr_decisions.

pro_handoff_engine.py escalation state is deterministic (safety flags -> professional_required; category rules -> professional_recommended), briefs are versioned & provenance-tagged per section, public /shared/{token} correctly returns 404 after revoke and strips user_id.

property_brain_engine.py fact correction preserves history (outdate old + insert new w/ corrects_fact_id + user_confirmed source), context-request avoids repeat asks (checks answered/dismissed state), answers write BOTH pb_facts and gr_evidence so the current assessment can use them immediately.

command_center_engine.py safety items always rank first regardless of focus preference; safety items cannot be deferred/dismissed (409); portfolio grouped into 7 states with pinned issues prioritized.

multimodal_engine.py /tts endpoint returns unguessable SHA-256 key, public /tts/{key}.mp3 has no auth dep and serves audio/mpeg with 1-year Cache-Control; simplify uses strict JSON prompt keeping safety warnings.
